crossRefs.note: Yahweh went before them by day in a pillar of cloud, to lead them on their way, and by night in a pillar of fire, to…
the pillar of cloud by day, and the pillar of fire by night, didn’t depart from before the people.
Moreover, in a pillar of cloud you led them by day; and in a pillar of fire by night, to give them light in the way in…
yet you in your manifold mercies didn’t forsake them in the wilderness. The pillar of cloud didn’t depart from over…
He spread a cloud for a covering, fire to give light in the night.

translations.web: The cloud of Yahweh was over them by day, when they set forward from the camp.
translations.bsb: And the cloud of the LORD was over them by day when they set out from the camp.
translations.kjv: And the cloud of the LORD was upon them by day, when they went out of the camp.
translations.asv: And the cloud of Jehovah was over them by day, when they set forward from the camp.
